hypotheses.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion due to Unindexed Query Lock Contention
hypotheses.description: High volume checkout transactions created row-level lock contention on orders table. Connection slots filled up to max_connections=100 limit, causing 504 Gateway Timeouts on checkout-service.
hypotheses.likely_root_cause: Missing index on foreign key customer_id causing full table scans and row locks during peak checkout traffic.
hypotheses.recommended_next_check: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on checkout queries and scale PostgreSQL max_connections from 100 to 250.

hypotheses.title: Redis Cluster Memory Exhaustion & LRU Key Eviction Latency Throttling
hypotheses.description: Active user sessions hit 100% maxmemory limit on redis_cache. Synchronous LRU key evictions introduced 2000ms latency spikes on auth-service.
hypotheses.likely_root_cause: Redis maxmemory threshold reached with non-volatile key TTLs causing blocking LRU eviction delays.
hypotheses.recommended_next_check: Increase maxmemory limit from 2GB to 4GB and switch maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru.

hypotheses.title: Kubernetes Worker Container OOMKilled (Exit Code 137) due to HTTP Connection Memory Leak
hypotheses.description: Worker pods for payment-service exceeded the 512Mi cgroup memory limit due to unclosed HTTP client connection leaks in the payment processor module.
hypotheses.likely_root_cause: Unclosed HTTP connection handles causing steady heap memory leaks until cgroup kernel OOM killer terminates the pod.
hypotheses.recommended_next_check: Apply HTTP connection pooling with explicit response body closing and increase pod memory request/limit to 1Gi.
